first_frame: output/出狱后我成为了非洲矿王_v2/keyframes/ep01/ep01_镜14/ep01_镜14_00.png
prompt:
The camera stands on the red-dirt road outside the prison gate at eye level, about 1.5 metres up, facing the rusted iron gate straight on. The camera is locked off at eye level. the framing eases from a close-up into a tight close-up. a slow push-in. the same 24-year-old Chinese man throughout, same face, same short black hair, same faded pale-blue shirt with the sleeves rolled to the forearm over dark grey work trousers.

His head turns a few degrees left and back once in a single small shake, then settles; as the last two words leave him his chin lifts another few degrees and holds there, and his eyelids stay open and still. He says in Mandarin Chinese, quiet and completely settled, each syllable placed: "不回了，自己干。". The ambient is pulled away for half a second, then one low drum hit lands.

Throughout the shot, his face, hair and faded pale-blue shirt stay exactly as in the first frame, and the prison gate behind him keeps the same rust pattern, the same peeling white wall with barbed wire on top and the same red-dirt ground.

cinematic ultra-realistic contemporary African mining drama, documentary-grade natural light mixed with hard sources, true skin texture with sweat and fine dust, real cloth physics on worn cotton, red laterite dust in the air, high dynamic range.
